03 — Our Story

Two Kitchens. One Table.

Wok N Soul is what happens when the sizzle of the hibachi grill meets the comfort of Southern soul food. One side brings the flame, the knife work and the umami; the other brings the generous portions and the recipes that taste like home.

You'll find us on South Alice Street in Dothan, Alabama — a small spot doing a big thing: food that doesn't make you choose between bold and comforting. You get both, in the same bite.

Fresh Off the GrillCooked to order over real hibachi heat, never sitting under a lamp.
Made to MoveBowls and burritos built for lunch breaks, game days and takeout runs.
Dothan ProudA local kitchen feeding our neighbours in the Wiregrass.
